description: This is a source file for the TalkModeRuntime class, which manages speech recognition, voice synthesis, and related audio processing in a conversational AI application. It includes functionality for handling recognition, playback, TTS via external services, and configuration management.

classes.name: TalkModeRuntime
classes.description: Actor responsible for managing speech recognition, TTS, audio playback, and configuration within the conversation mode of the application.

classes.name: RMSMeter
classes.description: Helper class for measuring the RMS (Root Mean Square) audio levels in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables speech recognition and processing.

methods.name: setPaused
methods.description: Pauses or resumes the recognition process, managing internal state accordingly.

methods.name: startRecognition
methods.description: Initializes and starts the speech recognition task.

methods.name: stopRecognition
methods.description: Stops the current speech recognition task and cleans up resources.

methods.name: startRMSTicker
methods.description: Begins periodic updates of the audio RMS level for speech activity detection.

methods.name: handleRecognition
methods.description: Handles the recognition update, updating internal state and triggering further actions.

methods.name: startSilenceMonitor
methods.description: Starts the loop that monitors silence to determine when to finalize recognition.

methods.name: checkSilence
methods.description: Checks if the current speech session has been silent for the configured timeout and finalizes if needed.

methods.name: startListening
methods.description: Transitions the actor into the listening state.

methods.name: finalizeTranscript
methods.description: Finalizes the current transcript, stops recognition, and initiates sending and playback.

methods.name: sendAndSpeak
methods.description: Handles sending the transcript to the gateway, receiving the response, and playing synthesized speech.

methods.name: buildPrompt
methods.description: Constructs the prompt for the chat request based on recognition.

methods.name: waitForAssistantText
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for the assistant's response text within a specified timeout.

methods.name: latestAssistantText
methods.description: Retrieves the latest assistant message from chat history since a given timestamp.

methods.name: playAssistant
methods.description: Plays the assistant's response text via TTS, choosing between ElevenLabs or system voice.

methods.name: resolveVoiceId
methods.description: Resolves a preferred voice name or alias to an actual voice ID, fetching from ElevenLabs if necessary.

methods.name: resolveVoiceAlias
methods.description: Resolves a voice alias to a voice ID based on stored mappings.

methods.name: stopSpeaking
methods.description: Stops current speech playback and updates internal phase/state.
